answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with sequential VDF chains: each identity must keep a verifiable delay function running, its kernel state advancing one step at a time, chained to its public key — no parallel hardware speeds a single chain. A public atlas maps every live chain, so one operator spinning up a thousand fakes must run a thousand chains in real time, each burning compute. The ferrous core of the defense is sequentiality itself: unlike parallel work, a VDF cannot be split across machines, so mass forgery pays full price per identity, per epoch, forever.
